title: Lock The Walk composition
question: Three compositions of The Walk. Which first viewport should the public folio build against?

options.label: One wall
options.thesis: The still is the first room. Type sits in the picture. The next rooms wait below.
options.viewport: Full-bleed student still as wall; name as a corner label; warmth band at the floor; large hangings hinted below.
options.risk: If the below-fold hangings shrink to thumbs, it becomes a slideshow again.

options.label: Two rooms
options.thesis: The first viewport already shows the suite: a large room and a second hanging beside it.
options.viewport: 62/38 two-room split; gold band crosses both; type in the left still.
options.risk: A split can read as a magazine layout instead of walking a suite.

options.label: Nameplate wall
options.thesis: The name is architecture on the still; walking continues as staggered hangings under the fold.
options.viewport: Huge name across the still; small corner links; next rooms below.
options.risk: Easy to slide back into a single hero with a next-slide control.
